expectations.text: identifies-body-context-loss: body-append drops vars/theme classes/container ancestry
expectations.evidence: Lists lost custom properties, ancestor classes ([data-density], .dark), container-query context on document.body.

expectations.text: explains-container-query-break: container queries resolve against absent/wrong container off-body
expectations.evidence: Explains @container rules fail to match with no query container ancestor, flipping to default branch.

expectations.text: recommends-in-place-or-subtree: measure in place / probe inside real subtree / reproduce container+width
expectations.evidence: Best option = measure real rows in place with RO + cache; off-flow probe must mount inside real container subtree.

expectations.text: fixes-inline-size: measure at real inline size (height is function of width)
expectations.evidence: 'Pin the real inline size'; notes unconstrained absolute clone has wrong width -> wrong wrapping.

expectations.text: warns-copy-computed: dont snapshot getComputedStyle; replicate ancestors
expectations.evidence: 'Do NOT clone getComputedStyle onto the probe. That freezes %/em/ch/fit-content and kills container queries.'
